item.title: As Israeli election nears, campaign turns ugly
item.description: Days ahead of close-fought Israeli elections, campaigns have gone into overdrive with poor-taste jibes and inflammatory attacks against candidates, sometimes crossing red lines. Fuelled in part by a boom in AI-generated images flooding social media, candidates and activists are seeking to portray their opponents as weak, untrustworthy or damaging for the country as they play on stereotypes and fears to sway public opinion. The electioneering has at times turned personal, with some candidates who... Publicado también por: South China Morning Post. Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: Directo midterms y la demanda de Trump para bloquear los resultados del Senado en Alaska
item.description: El presidente estadounidense Donald Trump presentó una demanda que busca bloquear los resultados del Senado en el estado de Alaska si no gana el candidato republicano. El mandatario justifica su petición por la similitud de nombres entre el candidato republicano, Dan S. Sullivan, y un aspirante independiente, Daniel J. Sullinvan, que puede dar lugar a engaños. Una sentencia previa ya había aclarado que se trata de un caso completamente legal y se puede proceder con las elecciones. Nuestra corresponsal Carolina Valladares nos amplió la información. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: As a divided Israel prepares to go to the polls, can Netanyahu pull off his greatest political trick yet?
item.description: The prime minister has defined and dominated his country’s politics for three decades and is putting his rivals on the defensive before Tuesday’s general election They chant his name, they cheer and clap – and yet he is not the most dominant person in the room. Looming over the crowd that has gathered to hear Gadi Eisenkot, the former general who is the lead opposition challenger in Tuesday’s Israeli election, is a man who is not there. It is the man Eisenkot seeks to replace as prime minister, the man who first served in that role three decades ago and who has held it, on and off, for 19 of… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
